scope: A2A signed cumulative live usage snapshot, provisional Zema display, and final receipt reconciliation

sourceState.workingTree: uncommitted; repository baseline and unrelated user changes preserved

environment: local built Worker/D1 through Miniflare with synthetic users, synthetic Ed25519 Provider keys, and controlled A2A fixture agent

implementation.persistence: D1 append-only per-delegation sequence with unique Provider event ID
checks: owner, parent job, task, agent version, currency, and signed price version binding
cumulative amount and line totals are monotonic and within held reservation
exact event replay is idempotent; changed payload replay is rejected
final signed receipt must reconcile the Provider, price version, task, time, and at least the last provisional cumulative amount
implementation.zema: owner-authenticated task list polls every 10 seconds while a remote delegation remains active; displays Provider-reported cumulative amount as provisional, separate from final receipt and held reservation

notProven: real Provider quote or live usage callback acceptance
Provider-side stop guarantee at the authorized spending cap
funded owner Wallet reservation, external debit, refund, or payment
Provider invoice reconciliation or production billing
carrier activation, physical SIM fulfillment, eSIM installation, or native OS installation
